title: Returned-Funds History and the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Bank Transfer Amount
content:
On the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan, the amount of a next-business-day transfer to the worker's bank account is taken at the return share, read from the plan's transfer returns with the reason returned by receiving institution:

- **one half** when such a transfer return was booked on the plan in the last three months;
- **three quarters** when one was booked in the last six months but none in the last three;
- **in full** otherwise.

The date read is the date the transfer return was booked. Returns with other reasons — a failed delivery or a cancellation before cutoff — do not enter. A record falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than that date's.

| Latest return by the receiving institution booked | Return share |
|---|---|
| within the last three months | one half |
| in the last six months, not the last three | three quarters |
| none in the last six months | in full |

*Hypothetical:* with today 20 September, a return booked on 21 June (two whole months back) gives one half; one booked on 20 June (three whole months back) and none later gives three quarters; one booked on 20 March and none later gives the share in full.
